CommanderProfile.title: CommanderProfile
CommanderProfile.description: Global UEC commander progression, credits, unlocked technologies, and active planetary sector synced across devices.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the commander.

uecCredits.description: Total United Earth Coalition requisition credits.

contractsCompleted.description: Number of urgent UEC supply contracts fulfilled.

hazardsSurvived.description: Number of environmental hazards and dynamic events resolved.

unlockedTechIds.description: Bounded list of researched tech node IDs (max 32).

createdAt.description: Immutable server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PlanetColony.title: PlanetColony
PlanetColony.description: Per-planet factory layout, resource stockpiles, power telemetry, and active environmental hazard state.

biomeName.description: Display name of the planetary sector (1-60 chars).

buildings.description: Placed factory structures on the 14x14 grid (max 200 entries).

inventory.description: Map of resource IDs to stored integer quantities.

activeHazardId.description: Identifier of active environmental hazard or none (max 40 chars).

createdAt.description: Immutable server creation timestamp via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

MissionEventLog.title: MissionEventLog
MissionEventLog.description: Cloud-synced record of resolved dynamic events, supply drops, and environmental incidents.

outcome.description: Summary of player tactical response and result (1-160 chars).

creditsDelta.description: Net UEC Credits gained or spent.

createdAt.description: Immutable server event timestamp via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Root commander profile and cross-planet tech progression.

/users/{userId}/planets/{planetId}.description: Cloud-synced planetary factory grid, inventory, and biome state per world.

/users/{userId}/eventLogs/{eventLogId}.description: Chronological mission telemetry and dynamic event resolution log.
